Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(a)): (a) Subject to subsection (c) of this section, the Secretary shall issue a permit within 30 CALENDAR DAYS to a person who the Secretary finds:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-312(a)(2)): (2) A person whose application for a permit or renewal of a permit is not acted on by the Secretary within 30 CALENDAR DAYS after submitting the application to the Secretary may request a hearing before the Board by filing a written request with the Board.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-312(d)(3)): (3) IF THE DECISION OF THE BOARD DIRECTS THE SECRETARY TO ISSUE OR RENEW A PERMIT, THE SECRETARY SHALL COMPLY WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS OF THE DECISION.
